messages:
Ava (AE): @Jordan quick Q on LynxBio RFI — they want a Dedicated POC with private VPC + HSM, 3 model replicas, expected 30 req/s, 12hr/day for 2 weeks. Need cost + ops checklist by EOD.
Jordan (Sales-Eng): Copy. Do we have an internal price for a 2-week Dedicated POC (small reserved capacity) + ephemeral HSM connector?
Diego (Solutions Eng): For a Dedicated POC we usually recommend 2x A100-equivalent to hit ~30 req/s for a 13B model at seq<=1024. Rough back-of-envelope: $2,400/week per GPU reserved + infra ops support, plus ~$500 one-time KMS/HSM integration engineering. Need final model size and typical seq length to tighten estimate.
Ava (AE): Model is 13B open. Seq: 1024 typical, peaks 2048. Data residency EU-only. Can we guarantee EU-only on Dedicated?
Priya (SRE): EU-only yes — we can spin Dedicated in eu-west1. HSM via partner requires VPC peering + connector VM with strict firewall. Ops tasks: peering, KMS IAM, cert rotation, audit logs. Minimal checklist below.
Priya (SRE): ```POC checklist:
- Create customer VPC and private subnets
- Peer customer VPC with Redwood private endpoint (eu-west1)
- Provision HSM connector VM and network ACLs
- Create service account + KMS keys and grant least-privilege roles
- Configure egress rules and route tables
- Enable audit logging to customer SIEM (optional)
- Smoke test: tokenized prompt + upload/download flow
```
Jordan (Sales-Eng): From pricing POV can we propose: flat POC fee (2-week reserved) + one-off setup + capped overage at hosted rates? Example: $6,000 for 2-week Dedicated (all infra + support) + $1,000 setup + overage billed at hosted unit rates.
Diego (Solutions Eng): That works as a commercial starting point. Recommend also offering a hosted-fallback path in case HSM latency causes errors — auto-failover to hosted model variant with masked outputs. Mention fallback behavior in RFI.
Ava (AE): Legal will want deletion/retention language post-POC. @Mira can you confirm default policy we can commit to in RFI?
Mira (Legal): We can commit to deleting customer prompts/responses from non-persistent stores on project termination and retain minimal logs for up to 30 days for diagnostics. Will provide a short clause for the RFI.
ops-bot: uploaded a file lynxbio-poc-cost-estimate.xlsx (https://redwood.internal/attachments/lynxbio-poc-cost-estimate.xlsx)
Ava (AE): Great, can you both drop a 2–3 sentence RFI-ready answer I can paste into their doc? Need it in the next 2 hours.
Jordan (Sales-Eng): `We support Dedicated POCs deployed in EU-only regions with partner HSM integrations. The engagement includes VPC peering, KMS key provisioning, audit logging, and optional hosted fallback. Setup typically completes within 3–5 business days.`
Diego (Solutions Eng): `Recommended sizing: 2x A100-equivalent for 13B models at sequence length ≤1024; we can scale based on test telemetry. Estimated commercial: ~$7,000 flat for a 2-week reserved package plus a one-time setup fee; overage billed at agreed hosted unit rates.`
Ava (AE): Perfect, thank you both :thumbsup:
